name: Naruto Uzumaki
title: Number One Hyperactive Ninja
effect: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Rest 2 of your chakra: Up to 1 of your {Team 7} characters gains +1000 power until the end of your turn.
flavor: I'm not gonna run away, and I never go back on my word!

name: Sasuke Uchiha
title: Last of the Uchiha
effect: [On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's characters with 3000 power or less.

name: Sakura Haruno
title: Quick Study
effect: [On Play] Look at the top 3 cards of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Team 7} card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Kakashi Hatake
title: Copy Ninja
effect: [When Attacking] If you control 2 or more {Team 7} characters, draw 1 card.
flavor: Those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
title: Shadow Clone Specialist
effect: [On Play] If your leader is [Naruto Uzumaki], up to 1 of your characters gains +1000 power until the end of your turn.

name: Konohamaru Sarutobi
title: Honorable Grandson
effect: [When Attacking] If your leader has the {Uzumaki Clan} trait, this character gains +1000 power during this battle.

name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
title: The Third Hokage
effect: [On Play] Up to 2 of your {Leaf Village} characters gain +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.
flavor: Where the leaves dance, fire will burn.

name: Pakkun
title: Ninja Hound
effect: [On Play] Look at the top 5 cards of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Kakashi Hatake] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Tazuna
title: Master Bridge Builder
effect: [Activate: Main] Rest this character: Add up to 1 chakra from your chakra deck and rest it.

name: Rasengan
effect: [Main] Up to 1 of your characters gains +2000 power until the end of your turn. If that character is [Naruto Uzumaki], it also gains [Double Attack] until the end of your turn.

name: Chidori
effect: [Main] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's characters with 4000 power or less. If you control [Sasuke Uchiha] or [Kakashi Hatake], K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's characters with 5000 power or less instead.

name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
effect: [Counter] Up to 1 of your leader or characters gains +2000 power during this battle. If your leader is [Naruto Uzumaki], it gains +3000 power instead.

name: Substitution Jutsu
effect: [Counter] Up to 1 of your characters can't be K.O.'d during this battle.

name: Protect the Bridge Builder
effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your {Team 7} characters attacks, place 1 progress counter on this Mission. Then, if this Mission has 3 or more progress counters, draw 2 cards and trash this Mission.

name: The Bell Test
effect: [Activate: Main] Trash this Mission: If you control 3 or more {Team 7} characters with different names, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Get a bell before noon, or no lunch.

name: Itachi Uchiha
title: Crimson Moon of the Akatsuki
effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent activates a Jutsu, you may rest 1 of your chakra: Your opponent trashes 1 card from their hand.

name: Kisame Hoshigaki
title: Monster of the Hidden Mist
effect: [When Attacking] Your opponent rests up to 1 of their active chakra. Then, if your leader has the {Akatsuki} trait, this character gains +1000 power during this battle.

name: Amaterasu
effect: [Main] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's characters with a cost of 5 or less. Then, if your leader has the {Uchiha Clan} trait, your opponent trashes 1 card from their hand.
flavor: Black flames that burn for seven days and nights.

reveal.source: Shadows of the Akatsuki Reveal Stream
